command: cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; tail -16 gui-verify.log; printf "XQ_STATUS\n" > /run/voice-display.in; sleep 2; tail -6 gui-verify.log

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; printf "XQ_NEWGAME\nXQ_MOVE h2e2\n" > /run/voice-display.in; n=0; until grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS\|INJECT MOVE_FAIL" gui-verify.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 90 || break; done; tail -32 gui-verify.log; grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS" gui-verify.log
